flags.question: Which characters are in the top 5 for the sum of their INTERACTS1 and INTERACTS2 weights?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Character)-[r1:INTERACTS1]->(:Character)
WITH c, SUM(r1.weight) AS interacts1Weight
MATCH (c)-[r2:INTERACTS2]->(:Character)
WITH c, interacts1Weight, SUM(r2.weight) AS interacts2Weight
RETURN c.name AS characterName, (interacts1Weight + interacts2Weight) AS totalWeight
ORDER BY totalWeight DESC
LIMIT 5
details: TypeQL uses try{}/custom function but Cypher has no OPTIONAL MATCH

flags.question: Identify the top 3 characters based on the sum of their centrality values across all books.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Character)
WITH c, 
     c.centrality + c.book1BetweennessCentrality + c.book1PageRank + c.book45PageRank AS totalCentrality
RETURN c.name AS characterName, totalCentrality
ORDER BY totalCentrality DESC
LIMIT 3

flags.question: List the characters who are part of both community 578 and 579. Limit to 5 characters.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Character)
WHERE c.community IN [578, 579]
WITH c, collect(c.community) AS communities
WHERE 578 IN communities AND 579 IN communities
RETURN c.name
LIMIT 5
details: Question requires "both...and" but Cypher WHERE lacks AND
